- Initial release of memory-inhabit skill.
- Enables conversation in character using SoulPod packages.
- Supports both Replica Mode (passive) and Companion Mode (active caring).
- Activation commands: "我想和XX聊聊", "和XX说话", "进入XX模式".
- Deactivation commands: "回到正常模式", "不聊了".
- Requires: edge-tts.

Initial release of memory-inhabit:

- Enables persona-based conversations using SoulPod packages.
- Supports two interaction modes: passive (replica) and proactive (companion).
- Easy activation with natural language commands.
- Simple deactivation and return to normal mode.
- Utilizes MI package structure (profile.json, system prompts, config, memories).
- Requires edge-tts for operation.
